# porkbun_dnssec_record (Resource)

Manage DNSSEC DS records at the registry for your domain. Porkbun's API cannot update DNSSEC records in place, so changing any attribute replaces the record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porkbun_dnssec_record" "example" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  key_tag     = "5878"
  algorithm   = "13"
  digest_type = "2"
  digest      = "2f9b8d20eb9ee356fbd4b10bcf5ea18b975beb9f3bfcfd67c8bd9021d2e7b06d"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `algorithm` (String) The DNSKEY algorithm number of the DS record (e.g., '13' for ECDSAP256SHA256).
- `digest` (String) The hex-encoded digest of the DS record.
- `digest_type` (String) The digest type number of the DS record (e.g., '2' for SHA-256).
- `domain` (String) The FQDN of the domain.
- `key_tag` (String) The key tag of the DS record (e.g., '5878').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the DNSSEC record (format: domain:key_tag).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import porkbun_dnssec_record.example example.com:5878
```
